description: Update the server's membership screening form: set the welcome description and the rules new members must agree to. Only provided fields change. Requires the Community feature and the Manage Server permission. Returns the updated form.

description.description: Welcome message shown at the top of the screening form.

form_fields.description: Rules/agreement blocks new members must accept. Replaces the existing fields when provided.

required.description: Whether the member must agree to this block. Default true.

values.description: Individual rule lines shown under the label.

name: discord_update_membership_screening
